source.title: A revised diamond-graphite transition curve
source.license_or_terms: Published article; this package stores a limited scalar table transcription for research audit and does not redistribute the full article
source.original_payload: Table 2, Preferred thermodynamic data for diamond and graphite (per mole)
source.preprocessing: Manual transcription of the cited Table 2 values and formulas; printed units retained; no cross-source merge, extrapolation, fit, or synthetic row generation
source.unit_convention: Table values retain J bar^-1, kbar, kbar K^-1, and K^-1; no SI conversion is emitted by this route
source.material_label: graphite data assembled for a diamond-graphite thermodynamic transition assessment

table_transcription.table_role: Preferred thermodynamic data for diamond and graphite (per mole)

table_notes.heat_capacity: Cp(T) coefficients are per mole and are not used as a Ding C_src row
table_notes.graphite_volume: V(T)/V0 expression is the graphite thermal-expansion relation
table_notes.source_composition: The article identifies the graphite thermal-expansion expression with Holland and Powell (1998), while B0 and n are selected from other cited measurements/assessments

claim_boundary: This package records a public Table 2 thermodynamic assessment and its explicit uncertainty boundary. It is not a same-specimen alpha_V/K_T correction input, not Ding mode-resolved C_src, not an independent alpha_Phi_K calibration, and not Full Topic 13 closure.
